acceptance.4_integration_decision_pending: test_each_proposal_type_is_created_through_the_real_route asserts decision_state=proposed and decision=None for both governance types

known_limits: Governance HTTP + PostgreSQL path for the new target types was not exercised here (no Postgres in the worker); propose-time rules and the state machine are covered in process.

The default Governance sender needs PANTHEON_GOVERNANCE_API_URL and a propose-only LESSON_RULE_PROPOSER_TOKEN whose actor id equals PANTHEON_LESSON_RULE_PROPOSER_ID; without them the route fails closed with governance_unavailable (503) and records governance_delivery_pending for retry. Provisioning that principal is an operator/deploy step.
Applying an approved gate-check or pool-policy decision is owned by the research gate owner and pool owner and is not part of this task.
The pool-parameter denylist (capital, risk, leverage, limit, execution, order, stop, kill) is a coordinator starting value.
Callers supply the composed case file; the converter verifies schema, digest, persona/tenant and that every cited lesson's memory entry is in it.
